messages:
maria: FYI customer (Acme Corp) says objects marked for deletion are still queryable after TTL expired. They did a normal DELETE via our API and got 202. :confused:
kevin: Can you paste the object id + org id and the approximate TTL/retention config?
maria: org: acme-corp, object_id: obj_8f3a2, they said default retention (30d) but also tried explicit delete. Customer timestamp shows expired on 2024-05-05T10:12:00Z.
priya: Any errors in the delete response or audit log? Also check if there's a legal-hold flag set on their account.
maria: Delete returned 202 with body {"status":"scheduled"}. No legal hold on the org via the UI. Attached the short audit snippet:
```
DELETE /v1/objects/obj_8f3a2  202  - user: api-key-acme-ops
ENQUEUE deletion_job id=del_j_112 queue=deletion-queue
delection_worker: received job del_j_112, status=started
delection_worker: KV-deletes ok, indexing: mark-deleted
indexer: mark-deleted failed: "index shard timeout"
```
kevin: Indexer timeout could leave object visible in search results even if underlying object blob removed. Can you check storage object existence and encryption status? Any KMS errors?
maria: Storage blob exists at s3://redwood-objects/acme-corp/obj_8f3a2.enc. Metadata shows kms_key: projects/redwood/keys/acme-key-1. No recent key rotation. I see a KMS log line: `Decrypt failed: HSM_UNAVAILABLE` around the same time as the indexer failure.
priya: HSM_UNAVAILABLE is a transient error we've seen during maintenance windows. If object blob couldn't be validated/decrypted during indexer run, indexer may have left state inconsistent. Need audit log export for the whole deletion_job window and confirm HSM outage timeline.
dan: I'll check deletion-worker backlog and re-run the indexer for that shard. Maria, can you trigger a manual reindex of obj_8f3a2 once I give the ok? Also we should surface this to infra and KMS oncall.
maria: ok. Running quick checks: storage HEAD returns 200, content-length 12893, metadata: ttl=2024-05-05T10:12:00Z, deleted=false.
kevin: That deleted=false is suspicious — our delete workflow sets deleted=true after successful index mark. Looks like deletion job failed mid-flight. We should mark obj_8f3a2 for immediate re-purge and force the index update.
priya: Before re-purging, legal asked if we attempted to export audit logs for compliance. If we re-purge now, will that remove audit evidence? We should export the relevant audit slice first.
audit-bot: Audit export for org: acme-corp, window: 2024-05-05T09:50:00Z - 2024-05-05T10:30:00Z is queued. s3://redwood-audit-exports/acme-corp/2024-05-05-0950-1030.tar.gz (ready in ~5m).
dan: Good. Action plan: (1) wait for audit export, (2) infra to confirm HSM status and mark any transient incidents, (3) re-run deletion job and indexer for shard-17, (4) confirm object no longer queryable and set deleted=true. I'll take infra/KMS oncall. Priya to confirm audit retention for that export.
priya: I'll download export and stash a copy in the compliance bucket. Also checking KMS maintenance logs now.
maria: timeline note for customer: we'll attempt re-purge + index fix within the hour and confirm. If we can't reindex because of persistent HSM errors we'll provide an interim access block.
kevin: quick repro steps for engineering runbook (maria please paste in ticket):
```
1) Verify object metadata: GET /internal/objects/{id}/meta
2) Check deletion_job: SELECT * FROM deletion_jobs WHERE object_id='obj_8f3a2'
3) Inspect indexer logs: grep obj_8f3a2 /var/log/indexer/shard-17.log
4) If index failure due to shard timeout, run: indexer --shard=17 --repair --object=obj_8f3a2
5) If KMS transient error present, coordinate with kms-oncall to retry Decrypt operation
```
maria: pasted into the ticket #SUP-4981. Ticket links to audit export and storage object path.
dan: I'll escalate to infra/KMS oncall now. Assigning owners: infra -> dan, security/compliance -> priya, support -> maria, eng -> kevin. Expect updates in 30-60m.
priya: Found a KMS maintenance window 2024-05-05T10:05:00Z - 10:15:00Z with degraded HSM availability in us-west-2. That explains the Decrypt error. I'll annotate the ticket and the compliance export.
maria: customer updated — they saw object still in app search at 10:40. I've informed them we're working and will follow up after reindex. :thumbsup:
kevin: After infra confirms, run a bulk re-purge for acme-corp objects with deletion status scheduled but deleted=false in the 09:00-11:00 window to catch partial failures.
dan: Confirmed with KMS oncall: transient, back to normal. I've triggered re-run of deletion_job del_j_112 and started indexer repair on shard-17. Will post logs here when done.
audit-bot: Export completed: s3://redwood-audit-exports/acme-corp/2024-05-05-0950-1030.tar.gz (md5: a1b2c3...)
dan: indexer repair completed, mark-deleted succeeded for obj_8f3a2, storage flag set deleted=true. Quick verification: application search no longer returns obj_8f3a2.
maria: Confirmed with customer — object no longer visible. Customer satisfied, wants postmortem on KMS maintenance coordination.
priya: I'll own the postmortem and add note about scheduling maintenance to avoid peak deletion windows.
kevin: I'll create a follow-up runbook entry to detect mid-delete indexer failures and auto-queue re-purge.
maria: Closing loop, updating ticket SUP-4981 with final actions and timeline. Thanks all :raised_hands:"
